title: Spectral Collapse Under Geometric Alignment of Extreme Events
summary: Let Q_n = B_n + J_n be the quadratic covariation matrix of a high-dimensional semimartingale, where J_n is the jump component and B_n is the diffusion component. We prove that spectral collapse occurs -- meaning the ratio of the leading eigenvalue to the trace converges to 1 and the effective rank converges to 1 -- if and only if the jump directions are geometrically aligned in a weighted sense and the background diffusion is asymptotically negligible.
